Description

Student-level records from the Global Youth Tobacco Survey (GYTS) in Morocco: tobacco and e-cigarette use, exposure to second-hand smoke, media and school messages, and family background, with survey weight, stratum and primary sampling unit for design-based analysis.

The GYTS is the global standard survey of tobacco use among school students. This file keeps one row per student with the weight, stratum and PSU needed for weighted estimates.

Origin

Produced by World Health Organization and US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, with the Ministry of Health of Morocco

Published in Global Youth Tobacco Survey (GYTS), Morocco

Tables used Not stated

How obtained School-based survey of students aged 13 to 15. Records were taken from the BioBench R package (dataset tobaccomorocco), which took them from the biostatlab package; blank answers are coded as missing.

Published on HDR HDR-MA-0003, version 1.0.0

Origin address: https://www.cdc.gov/tobacco/global/gtss/index.html (accessed 2026-11-02). Reuse terms: GYTS public-use data files are released by CDC for research use with attribution.

Variables

gyts_morocco.csv

One row per student

Variable Type Description
FinalWgt number Final survey weight
age string Age group
gender string Sex
income string Pocket money available
parent_work string Which parents work
father_education string Father’s education
mother_education string Mother’s education
living_env string Urban or rural
age_first_cig string Age at first cigarette
cigar_use string Smoked cigarettes in the past 30 days
noncig_use string Used other smoked tobacco in the past 30 days
smokeless_use string Used smokeless tobacco in the past 30 days
parent_smoke string A parent smokes
friends_smoke string How many close friends smoke
home_SHS string Exposed to second-hand smoke at home
outside_SHS string Exposed to second-hand smoke outside the home
indoor_ban string Supports a ban on smoking in enclosed public places
outdoor_ban string Supports a ban on smoking in outdoor public places
antitobacco_media string Saw anti-tobacco messages in the media
antitobacco_school string Taught about the dangers of tobacco at school
tobacco_media string Saw tobacco advertising or promotion
offer_freetobacco string Was offered free tobacco products
own_items string Owns an item with a tobacco brand logo
knowledge_harm string Thinks second-hand smoke is harmful
e_cig string Has used e-cigarettes
Stratum integer Sampling stratum
PSU integer Primary sampling unit (school)

Known issues

Read these before analysis.

  1. Demonstration entry. Taken from the BioBench R package to show how HDR presents a dataset. It has not gone through HDR review and will be removed before launch.
  2. Use the survey design. Ignore FinalWgt, Stratum and PSU and the estimates will be biased and the standard errors too small.

Found an error?

Tell us what you found. A curator compares it with the origin; confirmed errors are listed on this page and fixed in a new version, with credit to you if you wish.
